subtasks.description: Declare a read-only 256-entry 8-bit lookup table with the standard AES forward S-box values. The module interface ports (a, b) must be declared exactly as specified in S003, though the port list is part of the module header.
constraints: Table must contain exactly 256 constant 8-bit values matching the AES forward S-box, including corner cases 0x00->0x63 and 0xFF->0x16.
Port list must match S003 (input [7:0] a, output [7:0] b).

subtasks.description: Continuously drive output b from the S-box table entry selected by input a using combinational logic (e.g., assign b = sbox[a] or always_comb block).
constraints: Output b must be purely combinational with no register or clock.
Lookup must use the table declared in B1.
